table.title: Inline image in a bullet list

entry.codeblock: # Alarm Status Indicators - ![Active Icon](images/active.png) Active - ![Warning Icon](images/warning.png) Warning - ![Error Icon](images/error.png) Error

Alarm Status Indicators
  • Active Icon Active
  • Warning Icon Warning

section.p: Result: The converter preserves the image as inline content within each bullet list item. The image remains associated with the corresponding list item rather than being converted into a standalone figure.
